property_summary: For every call to transfer(from, caddress, _tos, v) where caddress calls back and reverts on at least one recipient, the reference C always reverts (transfer does not return true) while the mutant may return true despite callee failure; thus transfer never succeeds when any callee invocation reverts — the mutant breaks this.
change_summary: Remove the inner require(_s) that enforces each external call success, allowing transfer to return true even if one call failed (no revert on failed call).
